fr_html: M. FERNANDES répond que si l'on adopte maintenant l'article 16 sans tenir compte de ces observations, il faudra y revenir dans la suite.
en_html: M. FERNANDES answered that if Article 16 were to be adopted now without considering these points, the subject must be returned to later on.
